mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% historically compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS (below 0.25%) over 20-day horizon is below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window from 2000-2021.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 100,000 monthly additions signals robust corporate hiring and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 (2000-2021).

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales and financial services spending (RSAFS) above 600,000 million dollars indicates elevated consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for RSAFS over 60-day horizon is below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window from 2000-2021.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers Fed tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% (2000-2021).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and elevated Fed funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%) signals overheating with aggressive policy response, generating negative S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
regime_hint: overheating economy with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE < 4.0 and FEDFUNDS > 1.5) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances (2000-2021).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) during manufacturing slowdowns precedes S&P 500 underperformance, causing negative 60-day returns as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 (2000-2021).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,500,000 units (HOUST < 1500.0) indicates real estate weakness and reduced consumer confidence, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST < 1500.0 (2000-2021).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) and housing starts (HOUST < 1500.0) signal broad economic contraction, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (INDPRO < 100.0 and HOUST < 1500.0) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances (2000-2021).
